prompt:
A densely annotated editorial infographic plate, drawn by hand in confident ink
line with light watercolour and gouache wash on bright warm-white paper.
Contour line varies in weight and is charcoal near-black. Dimensional but not
photographic: restrained hatching, subtle texture, believable volume, selective
shadow, clean uncluttered background. Every material reads as itself — dull grey
lead, unglazed earthenware, weathered timber, damp fibrous bark — and materials
that differ in the explanation look visibly different. Quiet palette of stone,
clay, wood, and metal tones over the warm-white ground, with one or two
desaturated accents that each keep a single meaning throughout the plate.
Contemporary editorial typography: one calm display face for the title, one
highly legible face for the many small labels, sentence case, crisply printed
and correctly spelled. Annotation is dense and disciplined — leader lines,
brackets, dimension marks, magnified inset circles, small side studies — laid
out so no two leaders cross. Asymmetric composition with about a quarter of the
page left quiet. Modern printing on clean stock: fresh, crisp, and unaged. The
only lettering anywhere on the plate is the title, the deck, the labels, and the
short notes. The words hero, drawing, figure, plate, inset, zone, band, strip,
trio, column, and cutaway describe the construction of the page and are never
lettered onto it, alone or in a phrase: no headings that name parts of the
layout, no percentages or
proportions of the page, no tags in brackets after a label or note, no sentence
describing the drawing or explaining what the reader is meant to see, no
signature, monogram, date, watermark, or credit line.

The plate is headed "dalle", with the standing line "Turns an address into a repeatable artwork: words picked by the seed, a prompt, a generated image, a captioned print." beneath it.

The dominant picture, filling roughly half the page, shows A long address ribbon enters at upper left. It is joined to its own reversed copy, then cut into short windows. Each window drops into one of fifteen drawers of word lists, and a single word card rises from each drawer. The cards gather into a written base prompt sheet. An arrow carries the sheet to an external image service, dall-e-3, which returns a picture. A caption banner is laid across the picture's bottom edge. Arrows run in one direction only, from address to captioned picture.

Magnified circles set beside it show first circle shows one window of six hex characters scaled to a position in a word list. second circle shows three dominant colours in the picture averaged into the banner colour, with black or white text chosen by lightness. third circle shows the cache hit, where an already existing annotated picture returns at once. has four studies. The series filter narrows a drawer, and "none" fills it if it empties. The gpt-4 enhancement is an optional rewrite of the prompt. Orientation words set the picture's shape. tts-1 reads the prompt aloud into an audio file.

Colour is used so that Blue marks the repeatable path from seed to words to prompt. Rust marks calls to outside services: gpt-4, dall-e-3, tts-1. Green marks files saved to disk.

Draw these quantities as dimension marks or counts: 6 hex characters per window, drawn as a dimension mark on the slice. 15 attribute drawers, counted along the drawer bank. 9 output folders, counted in the fan. 8 phases, ticked along the foot. 3 dominant colours, shown as swatches in the second circle.

These trade words appear on the plate, each set against the thing it names: series on the filter study. attributes on the word cards. base prompt on the assembled sheet. enhanced on the gpt-4 rewrite. dall-e-3 on the image service. generated on the raw picture. annotated on the captioned picture. terse on the banner text. selector on the metadata file. audio on the tts-1 output. data, title, prompt on their folders. cache hit on the early return. setup, enhance, image wait, annotate, completed on the phase ticks.

Letter these words onto the drawings, spelled exactly as given: seed address, 0x1234..., adverbs, nouns, artstyles, colors, base prompt, dall-e-3, caption banner. 6-hex window, dominant colours, cache hit. series filter, gpt-4, orientation, tts-1. data, title, terse, prompt, enhanced, generated, annotated, selector, audio. setup, enhance, image wait, annotate, completed.

Set these short notes beside what they explain: Same address always yields same attributes; Address joined to its own reverse. Six hex characters every eight pick a word; Banner colour averaged from three dominant hues; Existing annotated image returns immediately. Series keeps only rows matching filter words; Enhancement is the one unrepeatable step. ETA from moving averages of past phases. One file per address in each folder.
